questions.question: What false assurance do the prophets and priests give, in Jeremiah 6?
options: 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace
'War, war,' to stir up the people
questions.answer: 'Peace, peace,' when there is no peace

questions.question: What does God urge the people to ask for in Jeremiah 6?
options: A brand new king, to lead them out together to the battle
The ancient paths, the good way, to find rest for their souls
Very great riches, to buy off the great invading army
The help of Egypt, to find some safety from the fierce enemy foe
questions.answer: The ancient paths, the good way, to find rest for their souls

questions.question: Jeremiah 6 says the people refused to walk in the good way and were not ashamed of their sin.
They have healed the wound of my people lightly, saying, 'Peace, peace,' when there is no _____.
Ask for the ancient _____, where the good way is, and walk in it.
